entities.summary: Chiaka Sylvia Ogbogu is an American professional volleyball player. As a member of the United States women's volleyball team she has earned titles at multiple international competitions, including a gold medal at the 2020 Summer Olympics and a silver medal at the 2024 Summer Olympics.
